title: Sinus Floor Augmentation With Autogenous Bone Versus Bovine Bone Mineral Mixed With 25% Autogenous Bone: A 1 -
authors: Year Multicenter, Split -Mouth, Randomized Controlled Trial. Jue A, Pijpe J, Wolvius E, Naenni N, Strauss FJ, Jonker B. Maxillary Sinus Floor Augmentation With Autogenous Bone Versus Bovine Bone Mineral Mixed With 25% Autogenous Bone: A 1 -Year Multicenter, Split-Mouth, Randomized Controlled Trial. Clin Oral Implants Res. 2025 Jul;36(7):859-870.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Implants placed after MSFA with AB or BBM showed comparable results. This indicates that MSFA can be successfully performed without requiring AB from an additional donor site, potentially reducing patient morbidity” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
